meta.take: first candidate of the day (time order; same minute: highest score) with score >= threshold; then nothing more that day

feature_doc.oi_near_log: log10(1 + call + put OI at the 5 strikes nearest the money)
feature_doc.oi_near_chg_pct: % change of call + put OI (11 strikes nearest the money) since the day's first chain minute
feature_doc.writer_tilt30: put OI % change minus call OI % change over 30 min (11 near strikes), x side
feature_doc.buildup: build-up over 30 min: +2 long build-up, +1 short covering, -1 long unwinding, -2 short build-up, x side
feature_doc.pcr_oi_chg30: put/call OI ratio (11 near strikes) now minus 30 min ago, x side
feature_doc.pcr_vol: (put volume / call volume since 09:15, 11 near strikes) - 1, x side
feature_doc.pcr_rank5: (rank of today's put/call OI ratio among the last 5 sessions at this minute) - 0.5, x side
feature_doc.maxpain_dist_pct: (max-pain strike - index) / index x 100, x side
feature_doc.wall_ahead_pct: % distance to the biggest OI wall on the trade's way (call: call-OI wall above; put: put wall below)
feature_doc.wall_behind_pct: % distance to the other side's biggest OI wall (behind the trade)
feature_doc.iv_rank60: ATM IV rank (min-max) among the last 60 sessions at this minute
feature_doc.iv_chg_day: ATM IV now minus at the day's first chain minute (IV points)
feature_doc.smile_curv: (put IV 3 strikes below + call IV 3 strikes above) / 2 - ATM IV
feature_doc.term_slope: NIFTY only: monthly ATM IV - weekly ATM IV
feature_doc.gex_norm: net gamma exposure / gross (calls +, puts -), the 21-strike chain
feature_doc.flip_dist_pct: % distance from the index to the gamma-flip level (+-3% grid), x side
feature_doc.synth_basis_bps: synthetic futures premium from put-call parity at the ATM strike, basis points
feature_doc.delta_abs: |delta| of the contract the setup buys
feature_doc.gamma_1pct: change in that contract's delta for a 1% index move
feature_doc.theta_pct_day: that contract's theta per session as % of its premium
feature_doc.vega_pct: that contract's premium change for +1 IV point, % of premium
feature_doc.vix_rank60: India VIX rank among the last 60 sessions at this minute
feature_doc.va_pos: (index - previous day's POC) / (VAH - VAL), x side
feature_doc.event_rbi_budget: 1 on an RBI policy or Union Budget day
feature_doc.post_us_event: 1 on the first session after a US FOMC decision or US CPI release
feature_doc.other_expiry_today: 1 when another of NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / FINNIFTY / MIDCPNIFTY expires today
feature_doc.fii_fut_long_share: FII index-futures long share, previous session's NSE participant OI
feature_doc.fii_fut_long_chg: its change from the session before
